raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

An L3 hit shorter than one sliding window, under a mid-tree anchor, is dropped in both host-memory modes. It is the usual hit when a reader holds a prefix on device and another writer stored its continuation, e.g. a PD decode offloading its output KV.

End to end (PD with decode KV offload, hybrid SWA + Mamba model, window 512, page 128; a 512-token prompt whose decode wrote KV up to 768), the next turn's prefill reuse:

| prefill host memory | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `cache` (`write_back`) | 512 (its own prompt; the 256 stored tokens are dropped) | 768 |
| `buffer_only` | 512 (the lookup is declined) | 768 |

Every turn's logprobs match a no-cache reference (max drift 4.4e-16). Run on a fork carrying this change.

## Modifications

- **Cache mode** (Python and Rust tree cores): `SWAComponent.prepare_prefetch` stages `min(span, window)` pages at any anchor, and the SWA prefetch commit no longer drops a short window under a non-root anchor. The window head is the anchor path's own SWA; the match validator (`create_match_validator`) accepts a boundary only after a full contiguous SWA window, so a short window whose head is gone never matches.
- **Buffer mode**: remove the full-window lookup minimum (`resolve_prefetch_threshold`). A staged hold pins FULL, not SWA, so the head of a staged short window can be evicted while it waits (the concern behind #39283); admission now refetches when this pass's joint match no longer reaches the window's start.

## Accuracy Tests

No kernel or forward change.

| test | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `test_hicache_l3_prefetch_attaches_a_sub_window_suffix_under_a_device_anchor` (new) | fails | passes |
| `test_buffer_only_hit_restores_a_window_shorter_than_full` (new; root, and mid-tree with `window - 1` and `window` pages) | fails (declined) | passes |
| `test_buffer_only_sub_window_hit_refetches_when_its_window_head_is_evicted` (new) | fails without the admission check | passes |
| `test_mid_tree_sub_window_swa_prefetch_is_attached` (replaces `..._is_released`; both tree cores) and Rust `prefetch_commit_attaches_a_sub_window_hit_under_a_non_root_anchor` | encoded the drop | pass |

`test_buffer_only_swa_window_semantics` is removed: it pinned the full-window minimum. `test/registered/unit/mem_cache/unified_radix_cache/`: 1080 passed, 0 failed (main: 1065, 0). `sglang-radix-tree` lib tests: 942 passed.

Not run here: the GPU suites (`test_unified_radix_cache_kl_hybrid_bitexact.py`, incl. `TestUnifiedHybridBufferOnlyBitExact`).

Related: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46934, https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46935, https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46936, https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46940.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).
